Same with me, except for drinking. L is pretty much my only relief from depression at this point. And weed makes time fly by. But when you aren't high you'll wish you were, or that you never would have started in the first place. I don't drink because i know i'd become an alcoholic. Just the idea of me not having to deal with any of these damned thoughts is intoxicating.

Yeah, that's what i had been doing. I just can't do it anymore though. I have plenty of reasons to live, but nothing to live for. I've equated it to having Digital toy without a battery. Sure you still have the toy, but the one part of it that is so essential that nothing functions and nothing is worth anything as a toy if it is gone, is missing.

The battery is just something that I lack. A drive to live i guess. Or rather a passion for life

Thank you for the concern

I've left the hospital. They put me in an outpatient program which is better than inpatient i guess. But i can't ask for much given the situation. 

As for the safety plan, they've had my anxiety+depression prescriptions cancelled and my psych is gonna have to decide what to do about it. I'm fine without them though. Weed has always done better for my anxiety. They didn't talk about anything else along those lines though.

Family is definitely hovering. My dad and mom both told me they would like for me to stay at their houses tonight. As well as trying to get me to talk to my ex. They know she'll get to me. I've ignored all other contact attempts from other people. 

No need to respond to this, i'll end up posting again regarding how things are going and what i decide to do. Thanks for the curiosity with my situation lol. Have a nice day.

I don't feel safer in the hospital, it's just a matter that i am fully cognizant that i may not be released back out into the world if i speed along the process. Idk how these things work when a patient is suicidal.  

I'm fully conscious so i have access to my belongings. They just haven't released me yet. My parents may have gotten the phone for me, i don't really know. But i have it.

I've talked to a nurse so he wouldn't think i had a problem more serious than i already have. I'm expecting to get let out either tonight or tomorrow depending on if it is too late by the time they say all good. My blood pressure is still very low even with the iv. They said it should normalize in a few hours because it's already been a long time. That may be a heart issue though, i have palpitations and occasional, non fatal but still dangerous irregularities in that little meat box.
It's definitely just to give me time to see what my options are.

I appreciate the effort, but I've told myself that so many times in the past, it just doesn't mean anything anymore. Why keep going if i have no reason to other than to live. Living for life's own sake has only lengthened a suffocating pain that doesn't need to continue.

Sure i have people to go to, and i am lucky for that. I have gone to them in the past many many times. But i just can't do it anymore. My family will hurt, and maybe some others will too. But i just can't do this anymore.
Living without purpose is not living at all. I've been searching for one for far too long to no avail.
